recognize_zh: 肝臟切片（H&E）中，肝細胞索之間的竇狀隙（sinusoid）塞滿核偏位的漿細胞樣細胞，左側匯管區亦有密集同類細胞浸潤，符合漿細胞白血病的肝臟浸潤。
features: Liver parenchyma with hepatocyte plates separated by dilated sinusoids
Sinusoids filled with discohesive cells having round eccentric nuclei and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm (plasmacytoid)
Dense sheet-like infiltrate of similar cells in a portal/periportal area at left
Some cells with coarse clockface chromatin and perinuclear clearing
describe_en: Section of liver shows a diffuse sinusoidal infiltrate of discohesive cells with round eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, consistent with plasma cells, accompanied by a dense portal infiltrate of similar cells at the left. Hepatocyte plates are preserved without significant necrosis. The sinusoidal distribution reflects hematogenous spread of a circulating neoplasm. Findings are consistent with hepatic involvement by a plasma cell neoplasm, compatible with plasma cell leukemia in the appropriate context; CD138 and kappa/lambda immunostains or ISH are recommended to confirm clonality.

ddx.vs: Extramedullary hematopoiesis contains mixed erythroid precursors, megakaryocytes and granulocytes rather than a monotonous plasmacytoid population.

ddx.dx: Hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma or leukemic lymphoma
ddx.vs: Sinusoidal lymphoma cells lack eccentric nuclei and hofs and are CD3 or CD20 positive and CD138 negative.
Reactive infiltrates are mixed lymphocytes and polytypic plasma cells, mostly portal with interface activity, not diffuse monotypic sinusoidal filling.
